title: Idempotency-Key hardening
context: Idempotency was scoped into T3.1 but needs a dedicated hardening + test pass given it's explicitly listed as a non-functional requirement in the PRD.
objective: Confirm and harden idempotency behavior on POST /checkout_sessions under concurrent/duplicate calls.
scope_in: Test sending the same Idempotency-Key twice in quick succession (simulating a retry)
Confirm no duplicate session or duplicate Razorpay order is ever created
acceptance_criteria: Two rapid POSTs with the same Idempotency-Key return the same session id
No duplicate Firestore document is created
Test covers this explicitly, not just manual spot-check
